name: webtorrent
description_en: ⚡️ Streaming torrent client for the web
readme_excerpt: WebTorrent The streaming torrent client. For node.js and the web. Sponsored by          WebTorrent is a streaming torrent client for node.js and the browser. YEP, THAT'S RIGHT. THE BROWSER. It's written completely in JavaScript – the language of the web – so the same code works in both runtimes. In node.js, this module is a simple torrent client, using TCP and UDP to talk to other torrent clients. In the browser, WebTorrent uses WebRTC (data channels) for…
